title: Adaptive Training of Random Mapping for Data Quantization
review_status: full-text audit complete; offset adaptation, random-subset setup, dataset-specific retrieval results, and uncertainty limits checked
sections_checked: CIFAR-10/MNIST data and random subset construction
mAP results over code bits and sample counts
evidence_note: ATQ generally ranks well on CIFAR-10 but Spectral Hashing often leads on MNIST; the authors note result fluctuations as sample counts change. Evaluates retrieval mAP on two image datasets, not energy or deployment latency; no reported uncertainty intervals/repeated-run estimates in the inspected experiments.

title: A Survey of Model Compression and Acceleration for Deep Neural Networks
review_status: full-text audit complete; taxonomy, evaluated resource metrics, historical scope, and survey-method boundary checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv first submitted 2017-10-23; v9 revised 2020-06-14; IEEE Signal Processing Magazine reference on arXiv
evidence_note: Broad narrative survey of four method families and historical benchmarks. It is not presented as a reproducible systematic search/screening review; its synthesis predates current edge and foundation-model deployment contexts. Operation/model-size metrics do not universally predict target-device latency/energy.

title: Structured Multi-Hashing for Model Compression
review_status: full-text audit complete; structured multi-hash, parameter/accuracy results, architecture variation, and latency-measurement boundary checked
evidence_note: Reports 75% fewer ResNet32 parameters with no CIFAR-10 accuracy loss and a 10× compressed model above 90% accuracy. Accuracy-versus-parameter trends differ between ResNet and EfficientNet/MobileNet families. The paper asserts low latency overhead from structured locality, but core plots compare accuracy and parameter budget rather than broad device-specific energy/latency.

title: Shallow-Deep Networks: Understanding and Mitigating Network Overthinking
review_status: full-text audit complete for previously uncovered exact-version uniform-random record
sections_checked: confidence policy and holdout threshold selection
CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny ImageNet FLOP/accuracy results
evidence_note: Confidence-based early exit is evaluated in FLOPs on three image tasks; task/model tradeoffs differ and heads increase storage. Label-aware exits are an oracle ceiling. No distribution-shift or cross-device latency/energy evaluation; backdoor mitigation is one setup.

title: Tensorial Neural Networks: Generalization of Neural Networks and Application to Model Compression
review_status: prior full-text audit reconciled for exact frozen sample version; not counted as a new read
evidence_note: At nominal 10% parameters on ResNet32/CIFAR-10, relative performance depends on decomposition: TNN-mCP 91.28% vs NN-CP 88.50%; TNN-mTK 81.59% vs NN-TK 86.73%; TNN-mTT 87.89% vs NN-TT 87.08%; uncompressed 93.2%. Parameter count is not latency/energy.
